hotel_name: Spot On Blue Heart Guest House

positive_snippets:
AC Rooms Not Abviable
Perfect in Winter Season 😜😜
negative_snippets: The condition of the room was very bad, and even the bed sheets were dirty and smelled bad. I told their staff to change them, but he said they cannot be changed. There was neither an AC nor a TV in the room, even though everything was shown in the photos. My first experience itself was terrible, and the washroom was also not clean. Staying here was just a waste of money.
